name: Option row
summary: The repeatable option/answer row — one bordered row with an inside drag handle, a borderless counted textarea, an optional correct toggle (circle or square) and per-option image, and a floating delete revealed on hover or focus; marking correct paints the whole card in the correct-answer green (SETTINGS-20/34/23/39).
highlights: Drag handle, borderless counted textarea, optional correct toggle, per-option image
Marking correct paints the whole card in the correct-answer green
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-option-row> — the repeatable option/answer row, composed from DS primitives. Its UNIVERSAL CORE (SETTINGS-34): the ROW carries the ONE border (radius 8) — the text field inside is a BORDERLESS counted textarea (no box-in-a-box / double border); the drag handle is the FIRST child INSIDE that border (not a column to its left); the delete is the secondary small icon Button (28, radius 4, system-trash) centred on the top-right corner, revealed on hover or keyboard focus and a Tab stop after the field (skipped when disabled); Backspace in an empty field is the quick keyboard delete and disabled at the minimum item count (SETTINGS-23). Per-type extras compose in only when the type has them — a correct-answer toggle (scored types) and the per-option image control (SETTINGS-22). The correct toggle has two shapes (`checkboxShape`, default `circle`): a 20px circle with a 1px #D4D4D4 outline, or a radius-6 square; either FILLS correct green (`answer-correct`) with a white tick when marked correct, and the WHOLE card paints it (an `answer-correct` edge over the `answer-correct-tint-5` fill; colour rule 11: the one green marks a correct answer and nothing else). The per-option image control is the tertiary ImageActionButton (no border or fill until hover). With `singleLine` the field is a single-line answer — Enter is blocked and the text is trimmed on blur. The drag handle appears only when order matters (`orderable`); an unordered set is not numbered (SETTINGS-39). Reuses <aha-counted-textarea borderless>, <aha-image-action-button> and <aha-button>. Every part of the row is centred on the row's vertical middle (the settings lab's alignment). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens.
codeNote: A composite element that COMPOSES DS leaves (never re-implements them): the borderless CountedTextarea, the ImageActionButton and the secondary small icon Button for the delete. The correct-answer toggle is a native <button role="checkbox"> (keyboard-operable, aria-checked kept in sync) rather than the square Checkbox, because the reference toggle is correct-answer green and shape-variant (circle | square). React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: the ONE border — 1px #E3E3E3, radius 8, 44 min-height, padding 3 10; field inside is borderless (no double border); handle, toggle, text and image all centred on the row's vertical middle

spec.label: Drag handle
spec.value: system-drag, FIRST child inside the border; shown only when order matters (orderable)

spec.label: Reorder
spec.value: opt-in reorderable makes the handle a tab stop (role=button) that reorders by pointer (reorder-grab on pointerdown) or keyboard (ArrowUp/ArrowDown emit reorder-move; Enter/Space emit reorder-activate); the host drives the move and calls row.focusHandle() to restore focus — the handle never moves the row itself

spec.label: Text
spec.value: borderless counted textarea — focus-only counter, wraps, scrolls beyond ~4 lines (SETTINGS-21)

spec.label: Correct toggle
spec.value: optional (correctable), scored types only — 20px circle (default) or radius-6 square, 1px #D4D4D4 outline at rest; fills --aha-answer-correct with a white tick when correct

spec.label: Correct card
spec.value: when correct the WHOLE row paints the correct-answer green: --aha-answer-correct edge over the --aha-answer-correct-tint-5 fill (colour rule 11)

spec.label: Single line
spec.value: singleLine → Enter never inserts a newline; value is trimmed on blur (single-line answers)

spec.label: Image
spec.value: optional per-option ImageActionButton (image), tertiary variant: no border or fill at rest, #E70E680D fill + #DB005B glyph on hover — the full state set (SETTINGS-22)

spec.label: Delete
spec.value: <aha-button variant=secondary size=sm icon-only> (28, radius 4, white, 1px #E3E3E3, #1A1A1A glyph; the secondary hover) centred on the top-right corner (-14px), revealed on hover or keyboard focus, disabled (not hidden) at min (candelete=false); a Tab stop after the row's field (a disabled delete is skipped), and Backspace in an EMPTY field deletes the row (the tooltip reads "Delete (Backspace when empty)")

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: hover → #E70E68 row border on the one persistent border

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: focus-within → #E70E68 row border + soft 2px --aha-focus-ring-soft ring (a correct row draws a single 2px --aha-answer-correct border, with the padding trimmed by 1px so the row does not move, 3:1 or more on the page), on the one persistent border

props.name: maxlength
props.desc: Character cap — turns the focus-only counter on

props.name: orderable
props.desc: Show the drag handle (order carries meaning) — omit for an unordered set (SETTINGS-39)

props.name: reorderable
props.desc: With orderable (and not disabled), makes the drag handle a tab stop that reorders by pointer or keyboard — the host wires both and moves the row itself; emits reorder-move / reorder-grab / reorder-activate

props.name: correctable
props.desc: Show the leading correct-answer checkbox (scored types)

props.name: correct
props.desc: Whether this option is marked correct — paints the whole card in the correct-answer green + fills the toggle

props.name: checkboxShape
props.desc: The correct-answer toggle shape — a 20px circle with a 1px #D4D4D4 outline, or a radius-6 square; both fill the correct-answer green with a white tick when correct

props.name: singleLine
props.desc: Single-line answer — blocks Enter (no newline) and trims the value on blur

props.name: imagesrc
props.desc: The image thumbnail URL when filled

props.name: candelete
props.desc: false disables the delete at the minimum item count

props.name: input / correct-change / delete
props.desc: Composed events; image-add/change/edit/delete are forwarded from the image control. `delete` carries detail.source: "keyboard" when Backspace was pressed in an empty field, "pointer" when the delete button was clicked; after a "keyboard" delete the host should call previousRow.focus()

props.name: reorder-move / reorder-grab / reorder-activate
props.desc: Composed events from the reorderable drag handle; the row never moves itself. reorder-move fires on ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the focused handle, detail.direction "up" | "down" — after the host moves the row element, call row.focusHandle() to put focus back on its handle. reorder-grab fires on pointerdown on the handle, detail.{pointerId, clientX, clientY} — the host calls setPointerCapture on the row element and drives the drag itself. reorder-activate fires on Enter/Space on the focused handle (no detail) — the host decides what activating the grip (rather than arrow-moving it) should do

props.name: focus(options)
props.desc: Focuses the row's own text field, so a host can move focus without reaching through shadow roots; options is passed to HTMLElement.focus

props.name: focusHandle()
props.desc: Focuses the row's drag handle — call after the host moves the row element on a keyboard reorder-move, to put focus back on the handle

whenToUse.when: a slide type's option / answer list — the "Items" list (SETTINGS-20)
a repeatable COMPOSITE item with its own body of fields (a Question)

opinion.note: The row is the one border; the field inside is borderless — never a box-in-a-box (SETTINGS-34). The drag handle lives INSIDE the border and only when order matters (SETTINGS-39). The delete is revealed on hover and whenever the row or the delete has focus, and is a Tab stop after the field (skipped when disabled); Backspace in an empty field is the quick keyboard delete (`delete` with detail.source "keyboard"; the host calls previousRow.focus()). It disables (not hides) at the minimum count (SETTINGS-23). No "X of Y" counter — the +Add disables at max and delete at min (SETTINGS-36).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab OptionRow control mapped into the DS. It composes the DS borderless field, checkbox and image control into the reference option-row anatomy (SETTINGS-20/34/23/39).
